# 22 Yards Houston

> Indoor cricket facility and academy in Houston, Texas (est. 2023): six lanes with professional-grade Gabba nets, BOLA and JUGS bowling machines, indoor box cricket, a cricket-specific fitness gym, a pro shop, and junior (ages 6–16) and senior (17+) coaching programs.

- Address: 14929 Westpark Dr, Ste 300, Houston, TX 77082
- Phone: (713) 570-9054
- Email: contact@22yardshouston.com
- Lane rentals: from $149.99/month; minimum booking one hour; 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule
- Box cricket packages: from $400/month, teams of 6 with flexible hourly slots
- Book a lane: https://axon22yards.com/book/houston
- Coaches: Harmeet Singh (Head Coach), Kamal Passi (Coach)
- Programs: Junior Development Program (ages 6–16), Senior Training Program (ages 17+), High-Performance Center (HPC) program with quarterly video-analysis assessments
- Events: birthday parties, corporate events, tournaments, workshops and clinics
